title: Loc Command Categories Scanner And Contributor Filter
description: Refactor repo client `loc`: internal git-aware snapshot scan (skip hidden path segments, recognized extensions only), classify Code (5 langs), Markup, Data (JSON LOC = object key count), aggregate rows Code/Markup/Data/Total, sort by LOC with Total last, always show percentages, add --by-contributor=<alias> working with --history, extend tests.
summary: Refactored `loc` to drop cloc: git ls-files / ls-tree + per-bucket counting (JSON uses recursive object-key count; other data/markup use physical lines). Skips paths under hidden segments (.*) in addition to .repo/gitignore. Numstat + snapshots include Markup and Data; composed rows add Code and Total with percents; tables sort by LOC with Total last. Added `--by-contributor` (filters git deltas and history commits; narrows `--by-contributors` map when combined). Extended TestLocCommand. Verified: `go test -run TestLocCommand ./repo/client/` and `go build ./repo/client/`.
